facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was solemnized on 30.11.1983. Out of wedlock, a daughter was born to them. Appellant/wife filed petition seeking dissolution of marriage on ground of desertion and cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: Parties who have not resided together since 2009 are deemed to be living separately
legal_principles.held: Ordinarily we would have granted the liberty to the appellant to file a petition under Section 13(1)(ia) of the Act, however, in the peculiar facts of the case and on perusal of the material on record, it is clear that the parties are not residing together since, 2009

legal_principles.principle: In the absence of reconciliation, a decree for dissolution of marriage may be passed
legal_principles.held: It is further submitted that in the facts and circumstances of the case, bearing mind the mandate contained under Section 13(1)(ia) of the Act, the decree for dissolution of marriage be passed as parties have not resided together till today ever since, passing of the judgment and decree dated 27.03.2018

outcome.final_order: Decree for judicial separation under Section 10 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 granted.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
responding to a petition for divorce
appealing against an order dismissing a petition for divorce
